//: W12 model registry. Model ids come from config/models.yaml's `executor` role (docs/STRATEGY.md §3, W12 row) — see output_apps/generated_modules/smartjudge/model_registry.py for the loader. Wired into .github/workflows/agent-task.yml via agent_runner.py's run_opencode(), which calls `opencode run --agent build --model <executor id>`. `ask` permissions are never used here: OpenCode runs non-interactively in CI (no terminal to answer a prompt), so an `ask` entry would hang until AGENT_TASK_TIMEOUT_SECS kills the run. Every permission below is explicit allow or deny.

plan.description: Read-only: explore the repo and produce a plan. Never edits, never runs shell commands.

build.description: Implements one GitHub-issue-labelled task in a worktree/branch (W10 phase 2, agent-task.yml). Runs non-interactively in CI: no `ask` permissions anywhere. Never pushes to main, never force-deletes, never touches secrets or the network directly.
